title: The Day He Made for You
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The morning came and brought the sun,
The birds began to sing;
And someone woke and looked outside
And praised Him for each thing.

[Chorus]
This is the day He made for you,
So wake up glad and see;
Some days are loud and some are small —
But each one's meant to be.

[Verse 2]
Some days are big with things to do,
Some days are hushed and slow;
But every single one of them
Is His, and good to know.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So Scout went looking in the rain
To see what might be found:
A puddle and a rainbow too,
And kindness all around.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Now close your eyes, the day is done,
Its gifts are gathered in;
Tomorrow is another one —
Sleep well, and we'll begin.

[Chorus]
mood: Waking-up music, played at bedtime. A light, unhurried strum that keeps an easy forward step, the way a child walks out of the door on a morning with nothing planned. Soft ukulele with an upright bass underneath marking the walk, and small bright notes dropped in between the lines like things noticed along the way. Bright at the start, and slowing gently through the last verse until the step comes to rest.
